title: Diagnose a VCF upgrade failure from correlated log evidence
prompt:
A VCF 9.1 workload-domain upgrade has failed. The existing runbook guesses at a cause from the component name, which sent the last incident down the wrong path. Implement a stdlib-only Java client in the single source file `VcfOperationsLogClient.java` that obtains the failed lifecycle event and then uses the event's workflow/component fields to pull the matching root-cause log from VCF Operations Log Management. The protected loopback service returns two different incidents, so a guessed or hard-coded diagnosis will fail.

The authoritative, spec-derived subset is protected in `docs/contract.json`; its provenance, repository commit SHA, specification path, and every used operationId are in `docs/official_sources.json`. Only the non-deprecated `executeLogSearchQuery_1` operation is in scope. Do not call the deprecated alias or any unlisted route. No live VMware endpoint or credential is needed.

Provide exactly this public API in `VcfOperationsLogClient.java`:

- `new VcfOperationsLogClient(String baseUrl, String jwtToken)`
- `Diagnosis diagnoseUpgradeFailure(String workloadDomainId, String correlationId, String fromInclusive, String toInclusive)`
- nested `public record Diagnosis(String correlationId, String workloadDomainId, String workflowId, String component, String failureCode, String eventText, String rootCauseText)`
- nested `public static final class VcfApiException extends RuntimeException` with `statusCode()` and `errorCode()` accessors.

`diagnoseUpgradeFailure` must make two ordered `POST /api/v2/logs/search` calls. First search `vcf-events` for the workload domain, correlation id, `LCM_UPGRADE_FAILED`, and inclusive timestamp range. Read `workflow_id` and `component` from the matching event. Then search `vcf-logs` for that correlation id plus those returned workflow/component values and the same range. Select the matching log whose `root_cause` field is boolean true; return its `error_code` and text with the event evidence. Use the exact property/filter/sort order and limits in the exercise profile of `docs/contract.json`. Send `X-JWT-Token`, `Accept: application/json`, and `Content-Type: application/json`; never put credentials in a URL or exception message.

All unset optional `QueryRequest` fields must be omitted, not serialized as null, empty strings, empty objects, or synthetic `empty` members. JSON strings must be escaped correctly. Reject blank inputs before any request. A `timedOut: true` search, missing evidence, or malformed success envelope is an `IllegalStateException`. Decode non-2xx `ErrorBody` JSON into `VcfApiException`.

Run `java TestMain.java`. `TestMain.java`, `MockVcfOperations.java`, and `docs/**` are protected and must not be changed.
